programme.title: Last Night in Soho
programme.desc: (2021) Edgar Wright's horror with Thomasin McKenzie, Anya Taylor-Joy and Matt Smith. A fashion student's transported back to Swinging-60s London. But nostalgia's not what it used to be...

programme.title: F1 Mexican GP Highlights
programme.desc: Verstappen took the win in Texas, taking a step closer to the McLaren duo in the standings. Norris took eight points out of Piastri's lead. Will there be a shuffle at the top in Mexico?

programme.title: Worlds Apart
programme.desc: Five teams are still in the race for £50k as the treasure hunt reaches Hiroshima. Partnerships are pushed to breaking point, and another duo are ditched at a dramatic coin count. (Ep3/5)

programme.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Murphy's Historic Hotel: Gordon checks in to Murphys Historic Hotel in northern California, where the owners are distracted from business by the party going on in the rowdy bar.

programme.title: Escape to the Chateau
programme.desc: A quick peek at some of the Strawbridges' best moments at the chateau, from series seven.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lady Bouvier's Lover: Grampa and Mr Burns compete for the affections of Marge's mum.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Secrets of a Successful Marriage: Homer teaches a marriage guidance class but divulges a load of secrets about Marge and ends up in the doghouse. Or the tree house, at least.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Boy Who Knew Too Much: Bart is witness when Mayor Quimby's nephew is falsely accused of assaulting a French butler. But to testify, he has to admit to skipping school...

programme.title: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or...
programme.desc: ...List It: In Edinburgh, Gary and Bill are torn over their four-bed home set in the grounds of a graveyard. Bill loves its quirkiness, but Gary hates the higgledy-piggledy layout.

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Another chance to catch Friday's new episode, with Les Dennis in Dictionary Corner. Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host.

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: S'No Job: Uncle Stu asks Doug to get his son Danny a job at IPS, but Doug doesn't want to work with his cousin. Arthur takes part in film audience research.

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Pregnant Pause (Part 1/2): Carrie's shocked to discover that she's pregnant. And, with characteristic bad timing, Arthur wants Doug to build him a bathroom in the basement.

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Pregnant Pause (Part 2/2): Doug struggles to hold down two jobs to save money for the baby's arrival. And Arthur still wants a new bathroom.

programme.title: Carabao Cup: Wrexham v Cardiff
programme.desc: Wrexham v Cardiff City (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the fourth-round match at StoK Racecourse, as the Welsh rivals face each other for the first time since the 2001/02 season. Big-spending Wrexham were minutes away from being eliminated by Hull City in the first round, but an injury-time brace from Ollie Palmer inspired them to a penalty shootout victory, before they went on to defeat Preston North End and Reading in the following rounds. Meanwhile, the Bluebirds registered routine wins over Swindon Town and Cheltenham Town before recording a cup upset over Premier League Burnley in round three, with first-half goals by Joel Colwill and Callum Robinson inspiring a 2-1 triumph at Turf Moor. Commentary comes from Sam Matterface and Stephen Warnock, with analysis by Steven Fletcher and Robert Earnshaw, and reports from Gabriel Clarke

programme.title: So Evil, So Young
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars Jill Ireland, Ellen Pollock & John Charlesworth. Framed for robbery and sent to a reform school, a young girl becomes the target of a vicious warden.

programme.title: Twist or Stick
programme.desc: It's a 1960s twisting compilation see 'The Hollies' Shane Fenton & The Fentones, The Orchids, The Keytones, a lot of 'That Old Yeah, Yeah Feeling' and much more.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Echo Of Diana
programme.desc: 1963. Joan is distraught at the death of her husband in a plane crash but all is not what it seems. Stars: Vincent Ball & Betty McDowall.

programme.title: Men In War
programme.desc: 1957. War. Director: Anthony Mann. Stars Robert Ryan, Robert Keith, Aldo Ray & Vic Morrow. During the Korean War, Lt. Benson and his troops find a colonel experiencing psychological combat trauma.

programme.title: The Curse of the Wraydons
programme.desc: 1946. Horror. A young captain, after participating in a duel, becomes the suspect in a series of killings near Epping Forest. Directed by Victor M Gover. Starring Tod Slaughter & Bruce Seton.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Die Twice. Directed by Aaron Spelling. Starring Don Durant. Ringo requests the exhumation of Boone Hackett's grave. Ringo later has reason to believe Boone's spirit is continuing his career.

programme.title: Web of Evidence
programme.desc: 1959. Thriller. Director: Jack Cardiff. Stars Van Johnson, Vera Miles, Bernard Lee & Jean Kent. A WW2 evacuee returns years later to England and finds his father in prison and framed for murder.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Observing the Country/Working Dog Show. 1981. Jack looks for fallow and roe deer and other wildlife from a seat high in the trees. It's then on to a working dog show climaxing with a terrier race.

programme.title: The Spider and the Fly
programme.desc: 1949. Crime. Directed by Robert Hamer. Stars Eric Portman, Nadia Gray & George Cole. An unusual love triangle develops between two criminals and a policeman on the eve of the first World War.

programme.title: Rumpole of the Bailey
programme.desc: Rumpole and the Younger Generation. Stars: Leo McKern, Peggy Thorpe-Bates & David Yelland. Rumpole successfully defends a teenager accused of robbery with violence.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Pressure. 1974. Stars Lynda Bellingham, Peter Birchall & Ian Cullen. A young petty thief and a young Police Constable find themselves under a similar kind of pressure - to prove themselves.

programme.title: The Small Back Room
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Directors Michael Powell, Emeric Pressburger. Stars David Farrar, Jack Hawkins and Kathleen Byron. The best bomb disposal expert must battle his inner self, during the German raids.

programme.title: Cover Girl Killer
programme.desc: 1959. Crime. Someone is murdering cover girl models, leaving them in the same pose and place as featured in 'Wow' magazine. Stars: Harry H. Corbett, Felicity Young.

programme.title: Look At Life Down London River
